# Stage 2 Freight Trajectory Generation

This directory stores the intermediate and final products generated by:

```text
codes/02DetailedFreightTripsGeneration.py
```

## Typical generated files

```text
preprocessed_od.txt
unique_ods.txt
corrected_coefficient_Winter.txt
corrected_coefficient_Spring.txt
corrected_coefficient_Summer.txt
corrected_coefficient_Autumn.txt
constraints_4hour_Winter.txt
constraints_4hour_Spring.txt
constraints_4hour_Summer.txt
constraints_4hour_Autumn.txt
constraints_summary_Winter.txt
constraints_summary_Spring.txt
constraints_summary_Summer.txt
constraints_summary_Autumn.txt
paths_Winter.txt
paths_Spring.txt
paths_Summer.txt
paths_Autumn.txt
optimized_assignment_Winter.txt
optimized_assignment_Spring.txt
optimized_assignment_Summer.txt
optimized_assignment_Autumn.txt
TrafficVolume_Winter.png
TrafficVolume_Spring.png
TrafficVolume_Summer.png
TrafficVolume_Autumn.png
```

The four `optimized_assignment_<Season>.txt` files are the intended trip/trajectory inputs for Stage 4, and the current Stage 4 filename mapping has been updated accordingly.

## Core information

The generated assignment files include vehicle/trip identifiers, assigned date/time-slot information, OD coordinates/city codes, cargo weight, and the road-link `Path`.

For direct Stage 4 use, the trajectory records must also satisfy the schema expected by the Stage 4 loader. See the separate maintainer note supplied with this documentation bundle.
